# XARU HOME

> XARU HOME is the global luxury real estate structure of NEXARU GLOBAL (UAE-licensed, Dubai). For 20+ years its senior team has guided private clients, families and institutions through significant cross-border real estate decisions: acquisition and sale of ultra-prime property (private islands, large-scale land, hotels and resorts, luxury villas), investment and fund structuring, developer capital, and complete relocation and corporate services. Property can also be acquired with digital assets (USDC, USDT, BTC) exclusively through regulated channels with full KYC/AML verification. Operates in English, Spanish, Arabic and Chinese across the UAE, Middle East, Europe, Asia, the United States and Latin America.

## About

- [About XARU HOME](https://xaruhome.com/about-us.html): The company, its NEXARU GLOBAL parent, the five pillars (health & wellness, ancestral local culture, eco-friendly practice, innovation, sustainable development) and global network.
- [Contact](https://xaruhome.com/contact.html): Private enquiries by appointment. Office in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Email contact@xaruhome.com / support@xaruhome.com. Private line shared upon qualified enquiry.
- [FAQ](https://xaruhome.com/faq.html): Common questions on services, acquisition process, fees and digital-asset transactions.

## Services

- [Luxury property acquisition & sale](https://xaruhome.com/property-listing-buy.html): Brokerage of exceptional homes, private islands, large-scale development land, hotels and resorts, and luxury villas worldwide.
- [Investment & fund structuring](https://xaruhome.com/index.html#investment): Real estate investment opportunities, fund structuring and residency-by-investment / golden visa guidance for private clients and institutions.
- [Developer capital](https://xaruhome.com/index.html#developers): Capital and structuring for developers of master-planned and large-scale projects.
- [Relocation & corporate services (CSP)](https://xaruhome.com/index.html#relocation): End-to-end relocation, corporate structuring and company services provider support across jurisdictions.
- [Acquisition with digital assets](https://xaruhome.com/index.html): Property purchase using digital assets (USDC, USDT, BTC) for qualifying clients, exclusively through regulated channels, with full KYC/AML verification and legal counsel in every jurisdiction.

## Entity

- Brand: XARU HOME, a brand of NEXARU GLOBAL.
- Licensing: UAE-licensed; registered office in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
- Experience: 20+ years advising private clients, families and institutions.
- Reach: United Arab Emirates, Middle East, China, India, Pakistan, Europe, United States, Mexico, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Panama, Dominican Republic, El Salvador, Nicaragua.
- Languages: English, Spanish, Arabic, Chinese.

## Compliance

- Digital-asset transactions are conducted exclusively through regulated channels, with full KYC/AML verification and legal counsel in each jurisdiction. XARU HOME does not offer unregulated crypto services and does not provide financial or tax advice; all figures and availability are subject to due diligence.
